cohort: 3,642,041 women with delivery admissions in California between January 1, 2005 and December 31, 2011
finding: While rare even in women with complex CHD, congenital heart disease was associated with increased odds of incident CHF, atrial arrhythmias, and fetal growth restriction, while complex CHD was associated with ventricular arrhythmias and maternal in-hospital mortality.
mod_finding: Women with CHD were more likely to undergo cesarean delivery compared to women without CHD.
